settings.subheadline: Practical, no-bullshit strategies for navigating ADHD, trauma, and the chaos of your own mind. Built on lived experience, grounded in the 3 C's: Commitment, Consistency, and Compassion.

settings.headline: G'day, I'm Just Some Bloke Who Figured Some Shit Out.
settings.body_text:
Look, I'm not going to start this off with a bunch of fancy credentials or tell you I'm some sort of guru who's got it all figured out. Truth is, I'm just an average bloke who's seen some shit, done some shit, and somehow managed to get over some shit.

I've been through the wringer with ADHD, PTSD, depression, and anxiety. I know what it's like to wake up and feel like your brain is trying to sabotage you. I spent years trying everything — therapy, medication, self-help books that made me want to punch something — and most of it felt like pissing in the wind.

But slowly, I started to figure out what actually worked. Not just what the clinical textbooks said should work, but what made a difference in the trenches of day-to-day life.

That's what The KC Theory is. It's not academic nonsense. It's a practical toolkit built on three simple things: Commitment to doing the work, Consistency in your efforts, and Compassion for yourself when you inevitably stuff up.
settings.quote: I'm not a doctor, and this isn't a magic bullet. But if you're tired of feeling stuck and ready to build something better, you're in the right place.

settings.description: Doing the work, even when you don't feel like it. Especially then.
Small actions, repeated daily. That's where the real change lives.
For yourself, when you inevitably stuff up. Because you will. We all do.
